当該選好領域において両公理を満たす社会選択ルールの構造を解明していると推測される。
reason_ja: 複合的な選好ドメインにおける配分ルールの公理的特徴付けを扱うため。

title: Incentive Compatible Mechanisms for Sequential Fair Resource Allocation with Private Demands
title_ja: 私的需要を伴う順次公平資源配分における誘因整合的メカニズム
abstract: We study a strategic variant of the canonical online fair allocation problem, where a planner must sequentially allocate a divisible resource to agents with privately known demands. At each stage, the planner announces an allocation rule, the agent reports their demand, and the planner allocates resources according to the rule and the reported demand. Unlike the standard model, we allow agents to strategically misreport their needs, as can arise in nonprofit settings where demand is self-reported and monetary transfers are unavailable. We characterize the structure of incentive-compatible (IC) allocation rules in this model, and use this to identify conditions under which the optimal mechanism has a simple cap structure. We then develop an approximation method for the optimal IC mechanism through a careful reduction of the discretized dynamic program to a longest-path problem on a directed acyclic graph. Numerical experiments show that ignoring strategic reporting can be substantially more costly than imposing incentive compatibility.
summary_ja: 需要が私的情報であるエージェントへの分割可能資源の順次的・公平な配分を研究。
戦略的偽報が存在する状況で、誘因整合的配分ルールの構造と最適メカニズムを特定。
離散化動的計画法を有向非巡回グラフ上の最長経路問題へ帰着する近似法を提案。
reason_ja: 動的な公平配分問題における耐戦略性とメカニズムデザインを扱うため。

title: A Characterized Softmax for Distributing Standing Across Multiple Affiliations
title_ja: 複数所属への立ち位置配分のための特徴付けられたソフトマックス
abstract: Cooperative game theory answers canonical questions on payoff allocation (Shapley, Owen), interaction attribution (Grabisch-Roubens, Faith-Shap), and coalition formation and stability. None answers a fourth question that arises whenever players carry known, overlapping group tags fixed independently of the game: how should a player's standing be distributed across the groups it already belongs to? We call this membership attribution, formalize it, and give a complete characterization of its solution. The direct, ratio-based answer is provably invalid whenever a player's group-level signals have mixed sign --- a common, structurally unavoidable case. We propose a restricted-domain softmax construction instead, and prove that, for any player satisfying a precisely defined richness condition on the group structure, it is the unique such map, up to a temperature parameter, satisfying five requirements. A sixth requirement fixes the sign of this temperature; a seventh, shown independent of the rest via an explicit counterexample, forces one shared temperature across all eligible players. A worked example on an exact cooperative game confirms the applicable requirements numerically and shows the construction degrades gracefully, valid but uninformative, when a player's evidence fails to distinguish between its groups.
summary_ja: プレイヤーが重なりを持つ複数のグループに所属する際の属性帰属問題を定式化。
符号が混在するシグナル下で比率方式が無効となることを示し、制限領域ソフトマックスを提案。
5つの要件により温度パラメータを持つ一意の写像として解を公理的に特徴付け。
reason_ja: 協力ゲーム理論における新たな帰属問題とその公理的解決策を提示するため。

title: Risk aversion with two risks for state-dependent utilities
title_ja: 状態依存効用における2つのリスク下のリスク回避
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the concept of Arrow-Pratt risk aversion within a two-attribute, state-dependent utility framework, where a primary risk is accompanied by a background risk. Within this setting, we investigate the interrelationships among risk aversion toward one risk in the presence of another risk, the structure of state-dependent two-attribute utility functions, and the degree of correlation between the two risks. More specifically, we establish conditions on the state-dependent two-attribute utility function under which risk aversion toward primary risk is preserved when a background risk is involved, considering various correlation structures between the two types of risks. Additionally, a new concept, uniform risk aversion in the presence of a background risk, is introduced. We show that the above established conditions on the state-dependent two-attribute utility function are equivalent to uniform risk aversion toward primary risk in presence of a background risk. These findings offer new insights into state-dependent preferences for correlated risks. Two applications in the contexts of fair insurance contract and optimal prevention within a two-period model illustrate the practical usefulness of the proposed risk aversion with two risks under state-dependent utilities.
summary_ja: 主リスクに背景リスクが伴う状態依存効用の枠組みでアロー・プラットリスク回避を導入。
相関構造を考慮し、背景リスクの存在下で主リスクへのリスク回避性が保存される条件を導出。
一様リスク回避の概念を提案し、公正な保険契約や最適予防問題への応用を例示。
reason_ja: 背景リスクが存在する状態依存選好でのリスク意思決定理論を拡張するため。

title: It Pays to Brag? On Counterfactual Fair Credit
title_ja: 自慢する価値はあるか？反実仮想的な公平クレジット帰属について
abstract: Intellectual work, such as software, legal documents, and scientific results, typically builds on the work of others, and the same end product can often be obtained in several different ways. When assigning credit for such work, it is not clear whether credit should go according to the way the work was actually produced or also consider counterfactual ways of obtaining it. We study this question by generalizing Shapley values to account for counterfactual ways of obtaining the same result. We show that the fairness axioms of efficiency, nullity, and submodularity (in particular, additivity) are incompatible with incentivizing creators to maximize social welfare. In fact, fair credit can uniquely incentivize arbitrarily small welfare relative to the optimum. We also show that without submodularity, incentive compatibility is achievable, and that the four classical fairness axioms uniquely determine the Shapley value and prohibit dependence on counterfactual outcomes.
summary_ja: 同一成果を得る複数の反実仮想的な方法を考慮できるようシャープレイ値を拡張。
効率性・無効性・劣モジュラ性の公平性公理が社会福祉最大化のインセンティブと相反することを示出。
劣モジュラ性を外すことで誘因整合的帰属が可能となり、古典的公理で標準値が一意に定まることを証明。
reason_ja: シャープレイ値の反実仮想的拡張と公平性・誘因整合性のトレードオフを論じるため。

title: Mechanism Design under Belief Disagreement: Allocation Flexibility and Rent Capacity
title_ja: 信念の不一致下におけるメカニズムデザイン：割り当ての柔軟性とレント収容力
abstract: A seller jointly chooses allocation and payments when buyers misperceive competition. Under independent private values, statewise participation, and payment restrictions, allocation determines both required rents and their delivery capacity. We separate these effects under a common subjective law. For three values and shared-top beliefs, explicit score and capacity conditions characterize globally optimal lower-value lotteries, including top-rent overflow and welfare differences among revenue optima. A two-buyer construction establishes a strict allocation advantage over every reserve under the same fixed reporting certificate and positive margin. A transport test and exact band-boundary incentive equalities identify separate conditions restoring objective-law revenue ceilings. For three bands and a common affine belief interval, an explicitly certified reserve attains the ceiling under stated score conditions. A case scaled to public collectible-auction records yields a nominal shared-top allocation gain of 24.72 cents per auction. A one-cent report-by-report margin yields matched gains of 1.48 cents under projection and 3.32 cents under shared-top beliefs; the three-band point-belief gain of 2.50 cents disappears with common-interval protection. These comparisons bound the additional recurring costs an allocation redesign can cover at the specified reporting requirement.
summary_ja: 買い手の競争に対する認識ズレに基づく単一主観法則下の分析。
割り当てが要求レントと収容力の双方を決定することを示した。
スコアと容量条件により大域的最適な下位財宝くじを特徴付け。
reason_ja: 信念の不一致がメカニズムデザインのレント伝達に与える影響を学べるため。

title: Subjective timing of information arrival
title_ja: 情報到来の主観的タイミング
summary_ja: 本論文は情報の到来タイミングが主観的である状況を扱うと推測。
意思決定者が情報の時点をどう捉えるかモデル化していると推測。
時間的選好や主観的信念に関する意思決定理論的分析と推測される。
reason_ja: 意思決定理論における情報到来の主観的評価に関心がある読者に適する。

title: Learning under Bounded Manipulation for Quadratic Incentive Design
title_ja: 二乗インセンティブデザインにおける有界な操作の下での学習
abstract: We study a repeated quadratic incentive design game in which a leader learns a follower's private type from noisy observations of the follower's actions and uses her estimates in an affine incentive rule. The follower knows the leader's learning policy, which incorporates past observations to produce estimates of the follower's type, and can deviate from his myopic best response to influence the leader's future estimates. We ask how the follower's ability to manipulate these observations affects the leader's performance. Under a manipulation budget $C_T$ constraining the expected cumulative squared deviation of the follower's actions from his myopic best response, we establish a minimax regret rate of order $\max\{\log T, \min\{C_T,T\}\}$ for approximately rational followers. Our information-theoretic lower bound applies to a general class of causal estimation and manipulation policies for the leader and the follower. We provide a simple learning policy that achieves the lower bound. Finally, we show that under a fixed learning rule, increasing the manipulation budget of the follower can counterintuitively reduce the leader's regret.
summary_ja: リーダーが操作可能性のあるフォロワーのタイプを反復学習。
操作バジェット制約下でのミニマックスリグレット界を導出。
フォロワーの操作能力増加がリグレットを減らす逆説的現象を示す。
reason_ja: 動的なインセンティブ設計と操作行動の下での学習理論を学べるため。

title: The Complexity of Fair and Stable Data Exchange
title_ja: 公平で安定なデータ交換の計算複雑性
abstract: Data exchange is a fundamental challenge for Web applications such as recommender systems, personalized search, and fraud detection, where combining data across participants can improve predictions. Sustaining such collaboration requires fair returns for contributions and protection against groups leaving for a more beneficial exchange. These requirements are captured by reciprocity, which equates each participant's received utility with its credited contribution to others, and core stability, which rules out any coalition exchanging its own data to make every member strictly better off. Akrami et al. prove that such exchanges exist under broad assumptions, but leave efficient computation open. Two fundamental cases are submodular utilities, capturing diminishing returns from overlapping datasets, and supermodular utilities, capturing complementarities. We settle the approximate computation of reciprocal and core-stable exchanges in both cases, establishing a computational separation under Shapley sharing. For cross-monotone shares, which include Shapley shares under monotone submodular utilities, we give a circulation algorithm that computes an exactly core-stable, $ε$-reciprocal exchange in time poly$(n,1/ε,L)$ given efficient access to approximate shares, where $n$ is the number of participants and $L$ bounds how fast each donor's credit changes with its own contribution. This yields an FPTAS when $L$ is polynomially bounded. In contrast, finding an $ε$-reciprocal, $ε$-core-stable exchange is PPAD-hard for monotone lattice-supermodular utilities, even at inverse-polynomial accuracy, with constant $L$ and exact polynomial-time evaluation of Shapley shares. Thus overlapping information permits efficient fair and stable exchange, while complementarities create a computational barrier even when contribution credits are easy to evaluate.
summary_ja: 相互性とコア安定性を満たすデータ交換の計算複雑性を解明。
劣モジュラ効用では近似相互かつ厳密コア安定な交換のFPTASを提案。
優モジュラ効用では近似解の導出であってもPPAD困難と証明。
reason_ja: データ交換における公平性とコア安定性の計算限界を把握できるため。

title: Logarithmic Tracing and Equilibrium Selection in Asymmetric Coordination Games
title_ja: 非対称追従ゲームにおける対数トレーシングと均衡選択
abstract: We study equilibrium selection in asymmetric pure coordination games with finitely many players and actions. A logarithmic regularization defines a tracing-type path of interior equilibria from the uniform strategy profile. We reduce the equilibrium conditions to single-peaked scalar functions and show that, when one associated payoff index is uniquely minimal, the connected equilibrium branch from the uniform profile converges to the corresponding coordinated outcome. With two players, this condition is equivalent to maximizing the sum of square-root payoffs, extending the known two-action result to finitely many actions. A three-player example shows that the square-root rule does not generally extend to more players.
summary_ja: 非対称純粋追従ゲームにおける対数正則化によるトレーシングを分析。
条件充足時に一様戦略からの均衡軌跡が単一の協調結果に収束。
2人ゲームでの平方根利得合計最大化則が3人以上では成立しない。
reason_ja: 非対称ゲームでの均衡選択問題と対数トレーシング法を学べるため。

title: Less Rational, More Transparent: Censorship as (Robustly) Optimal Disclosure
title_ja: より低い合理性、より高い透明性：検閲としての（堅牢な）最適情報開示
abstract: Online platforms often control the information behind user decisions they want to influence, such as whether a driver accepts a trip or a buyer completes a purchase. A classical result in information disclosure shows that a {\em censorship} policy is optimal for the platform: the platform pools all sufficiently favorable options under a common message, such as a quality badge, and reveals the rest individually. This result, however, presumes fully rational users. We study disclosure to boundedly rational users who follow the logit quantal response model and whose rationality level the platform may not know. Our results deliver a unifying message: less rational, more transparent. Neither bounded rationality nor uncertainty about it calls for a more complex policy; each changes only how much the platform should pool, and only toward greater transparency. When the rationality level is known, censorship remains optimal, and less rational users optimally receive at least as much information as more rational ones. When the rationality level is unknown, censorship remains robustly optimal under each of three criteria: the maximin ratio, maximin payoff, and minimax regret, and the robust censorship can be chosen to be at least as transparent as the policy designed for fully rational users. This additional transparency weakly benefits both parties and acts as insurance against behavioral uncertainty: rationality-robust censorship secures at least 89.96\% of the payoff attainable with knowledge of the user's rationality level, whereas the policy designed for fully rational users can secure as little as 50\%. Taken together, these results suggest that platforms can keep their badge-based disclosure but should narrow its coverage when users may be boundedly rational.
summary_ja: ロジット量子応答に従う有界合理的ユーザーへの情報開示を分析。
合理性レベルが未知でも検閲（プール化）政策が堅牢に最適と証明。
合理性低下や不確実性増加には透明性を高める開示が最適と結論。
reason_ja: 有界合理的意志決定者に対する堅牢な情報開示戦略を学べるため。

title: Mechanism design in max-flows with private capacities
title_ja: 私的容量を持つ最大流におけるメカニズムデザイン
summary_ja: ネットワークの容量情報が私的情報である状況を扱うと推測。
プレイヤーの虚偽申告を防ぐメカニズムデザインを議論と推測。
効率的な最大流の達成とインセンティブ実効性の両立を分析と推測。

title: Eliminating Make-Whole Uplifts with a Minimum-Cost Uniform Price Adder
title_ja: 最小コスト一律価格加算器による補填支払いの排除
abstract: Co-optimizing energy and flexible ramping reserves may dispatch generators at locational marginal prices (LMPs) below their submitted energy offer prices, necessitating out-of-market make-whole payments. Such payments create discriminatory settlements among generators and may incentivize strategic bidding for higher profits. This paper proposes LMP+U, an in-market uniform price adder to LMP for transmission-constrained networks, which minimizes demand payments subject to zero out-of-market make-whole uplift, preserves LMP-based congestion charges, and provides locally truthful bidding incentives for price-taking generators. We also identify conditions under which a price-taking generator can increase its profit by inflating its energy offer under conventional LMP with make-whole uplift. Numerical simulations illustrate the properties of LMP+U and its advantages over conventional LMP in congested networks.
summary_ja: エネルギーとランプ予備力の共同最適化における補填支払いを分析。
補填支払いを不要にする一律追加価格LMP+Uを提案。
送電線混雑下での需要家支払いを最小化し局所的誠実入札を保証。
reason_ja: 電力市場デザインにおけるインセンティブ適合的な価格設定を学べる。

title: Epistemic Social Learning: Latent Behavioral Structure under Endogenous Multi-Agent Interaction
title_ja: 内生的なマルチエージェント相互作用における潜在的行動構造と認識的社会学習
abstract: In multi-agent interaction, a learner's actions shape the observations from which it infers other agents' behavior. A behavioral model may predict these observations well yet support poor adaptation when opponents change. We introduce Epistemic Social Learning (ESL), which couples fast, interaction-specific Bayesian beliefs with slower online learning of population-shared behavioral prototypes. Belief-conditioned decisions influence subsequent observations and, in turn, the representations learned from them. Under explicit regularity and averaging assumptions, we provide a conditional stochastic-approximation characterization of these coupled dynamics. Across twelve synthetic $3\times3$ cooperative, coordination, and adversarial games, ESL achieves the lowest aggregate post-switch regret among the evaluated online latent-adaptation methods, including a switch-aware Bayesian filter. Additional experiments examine observation loss, noise, and asymmetric incentives. These findings illustrate how predictive fit can differ from decision-relevant adaptation under policy-dependent interaction.
summary_ja: 他者の行動を推定する学習において対戦相手の変更に適応する認識的社会学習（ESL）を提案した。
高速なベイズ信念更新と緩やかなプロトタイプ学習を結合し、意思決定と観察の相互作用を定式化した。
12種類のゲーム等の実験で、ESLが既存の潜在適応手法の中で最も低いスイッチ後後悔量を達成した。
reason_ja: 相手の戦略変化に対する信念更新と意思決定の相互作用に関心がある研究者に有用。

title: Stinespring's Dilation, Universal-NOT, and Limitations of Quantum Uncoupled Learning
title_ja: スティーンスプリングの可張定理、ユニバーサルNOT、および量子非結合学習の限界
abstract: Uncoupled learning, in which players know only their own payoff, are a standard model of decentralized learning toward Nash equilibrium. We study their quantum counterpart, where strategies are quantum states and, in each round, a player receives a physical copy of their opponent's current strategy and updates their own state by a quantum channel. This adds to uncoupledness a constraint with no classical analogue: every update must be physically realizable. In fact, this constraint is decisive in conjugation games, in which Bob has a strictly dominant pure strategy and Alice's unique best response is its transpose. In this work, we show some limitations of uncoupled (learning) dynamics in finding the Nash equilibrium for conjugation games. First, we prove that no autonomous, memoryless, uncoupled dynamics converge to Nash equilibrium in a family of four single-qubit conjugation games. Specifically, any memoryless channel that keeps all four equilibria fixed will leave Alice's strategy frozen. This result also extends to $4^n$ games on $n$-qubit registers. Second, we show that this barrier disappears with a small classical memory: for any finite family of $L$ pure targets, a guess-and-test rule with $O(\log L)$ classical bits converges to equilibrium, with an explicit bound on its convergence rate. Finally, we prove that no finite memory, classical or quantum, suffices for the continuum of all pure-qubit targets. Our proof of the impossibility for memoryless channels relies on Stinespring's dilation theorem, while the impossibility for finite-memory channels relies on the optimal universal-NOT (in)fidelity bound by Bužek, Hillery, and Werner.
summary_ja: プレイヤーが自身の利得のみを知る非結合学習の量子版における、ナッシュ均衡への収束限界を解析した。
共役ゲームにおいて記憶を持たない自律的な量子ダイナミクスがナッシュ均衡に収束しないことを証明した。
小規模な古典メモリで収束可能になる一方、有限メモリでは全量子状態の連続体に対応できないことを示した。
reason_ja: 量子ゲーム理論や分散学習ダイナミクスにおける均衡収束の理論的限界に興味がある研究者に適する。

title: Stackelberg Games with Convex Risk Measures
title_ja: 凸リスク測度を伴うシュタッケルベルク・ゲーム
abstract: Stackelberg games have important real-world applications in which reliable commitments require accounting for multiple sources of uncertainty. We study finite Stackelberg games in which environmental uncertainty makes each mixed strategy profile induce a random reward, and each player evaluates that reward with a convex monetary risk criterion. In reward form, it is a concave, monotone, translation-equivariant utility and also represented as penalized expected reward over distributions of environmental outcomes. We provide two conditions under which the follower has a unique continuous mixed response, which leads to inducible optimistic equilibrium. We show that even approximate equilibrium computation is NP Hard. We then derive an exact mathematical program with equilibrium constraints for the problem. We also develop an action entropy smoothed implicit-gradient method and prove an end-to-end additive approximation guarantee under the assumption that the gradient method reaches global optimality. We validate our scalability and other results with experiments on synthetic and real data.
summary_ja: 環境の不確実性から生じる利得を、各プレイヤーが凸リスク測度で評価するシュタッケルベルクゲームを分析した。
フォロワーの最適応答の唯一性と、誘発可能な楽観的均衡が存在するための2つの十分条件を示した。
均衡計算のNP困難性を証明し、行動エントロピー平滑化暗黙勾配法による計算近似手法と誤差保証を導出した。
reason_ja: 不確実性下の意思決定モデルやリスク考慮型ゲーム理論の均衡概念・計算に関心のある読者に適する。

title: Last-Iterate Convergence of Payoff-Gradient Learning in Möbius Pricing Games
title_ja: メビウス価格設定ゲームにおける利得勾配学習の最終反復収束
abstract: We prove global last-iterate convergence of payoff-gradient learning in every typewise Riemannian metric, which for scalar actions is the same as typewise mirror descent, with explicit rates, in a class of Bayesian bidding and pricing games that includes first-price auctions, unit-demand pay-as-bid auctions, rank-based generalized first-price auctions, and homogeneous-good price competition with inelastic demand. The result holds for symmetric self-play: all players use a common strategy and apply the same payoff-gradient update at each type. Convergence is from every continuous weakly increasing feasible initial strategy, including pooling, and does not rely on the monotonicity or Minty conditions that underlie existing guarantees in other games. Instead, the class is characterized by two structural properties: a direct payoff effect that is independent of the action, and a payoff difference at the allocation threshold that is affine in the action. These properties reduce the learning dynamics to a singular transport-damping equation for the common strategy, which, under the stated coefficient and metric assumptions, admits a unique viscosity solution. Comparison barriers make the uniform distance to the unique rest point a strict Lyapunov functional and yield convergence rates with optimal algebraic exponents. In allocation games, the rest point is the unique weakly increasing symmetric equilibrium under the stated tie-breaking conditions, and a positive lower slope bound converts strategy-error bounds into explicit approximate-equilibrium guarantees. A projected grid scheme with a slope floor makes the approximation constructive, with error bounds under deterministic perturbations and almost-sure convergence on a fixed grid under martingale gradient noise.
summary_ja: 第一価格オークション等を含むベイズ型ゲームにおける利得勾配学習の全域的な最終反復収束を証明した。
共通戦略の特異輸送減衰方程式への帰着を通じて、単調性仮定に頼らない厳密なリャプノフ関数を構成した。
近似均衡に対する明示的な収束レートを導出し、決定論的・確率的ノイズ下での計算可能性を示した。
reason_ja: オークション理論や学習ダイナミクスにおける均衡収束性・メカニズム理論に関心を持つ研究者に適する。

title: Kidney Exchange in Deterministic $O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$ Time
title_ja: 決定論的O*(4^{t+o(t)})時間による腎臓交換
abstract: Kidney exchange admits a randomized $O^*(4^t)$ algorithm parameterized by the target number $t$ of transplants, but the best previous deterministic algorithm requires $O^*(6.855^t)$ time. We nearly close this gap by developing a deterministic $O^*(4^{t+o(t)})$ algorithm. Our approach uses Dynamic Representative Sets to execute the semi-feasible packing recurrence under a global cardinality budget of $2t$, exploiting a residual extension-budget invariant to avoid repeated static representative-family compression. To handle admissible cycles containing at least $t$ vertices, we establish a deterministic $O^*(4^{k+o(k)})$ algorithm for finding a shortest simple directed cycle of length at least $k$. Beyond feasibility, our framework supports additive optimization, yielding the same running-time bound for maximizing arc utility among packings with exactly $t$ transplants. Consequently, a packing that lexicographically maximizes the number of transplants and then additive utility can be computed deterministically in $O^*(4^{τ+o(τ)})$ time, where $τ$ is the maximum achievable number of transplants.
summary_ja: 移植数tをパラメータとする腎臓交換問題に対し、決定論的なO*(4^{t+o(t)})時間アルゴリズムを開発した。
動的代表集合を用いて重複計算を回避し、長周期サイクル検出の決定論的計算手法を確立した。
移植数の最大化と加算的効用最大化を辞書式に達成する最適パッキングの計算理論的界を大幅に改良した。
reason_ja: 腎臓交換問題などマッチングメカニズム設計と計算複雑性に関心がある研究者に有益。

title: Risky College Enrollment, Dropout, and Student Debt Forgiveness
title_ja: リスクを伴う大学進学、退学、および学生ローン返済免除
abstract: The paper analyzes, by means of a theoretical model of two‐stage college study, the effects of two kinds of tuition subsidies, unconditional tuition discounts versus dropout‐contingent forgiveness of student loans. Students' imperfect knowledge of their academic ability at the time of matriculation and its updating in the course of study are factors in their responses to funding policies. Mitigating the resulting risk in college attendance is the rationale for government intervention by means of tuition subsidies. We find that while unconditional tuition subsidies incentivize both matriculation and continued study even upon the revelation of low ability and hence low returns to college, partial forgiveness of student debt conditional on dropping out maintains incentives to matriculate but adds option value by relieving a part of sunk tuition debt when evaluating a decision to persist in college. It thus reduces the incentives to do so when low future returns are revealed. We show that this policy is superior in terms of mitigating the “bad debt” held by students, that unrecouped by returns to college. Moreover, a budget‐neutral conversion of a part of unconditional tuition subsidy to targeted debt forgiveness increases aggregate net productivity gain due to college education and reduces the aggregate bad debt held by students.
summary_ja: 学力の不確実性と進学後の情報更新を考慮した2段階大学学習理論モデルにより、授業料補助政策を分析した。
無条件の学費割引と比べ、退学条件付き債務免除は途中退学時のリスクを軽減しミスマッチを防止する。
債務免除への財政中立な転換が学生の不良債務を減らし、大学教育による純生産性利得を向上させることを示した。
reason_ja: 不確実性下の意思決定や教育政策におけるメカニズム設計・厚生評価に関心がある研究者に好適。

title: A quick-fix for perverse incentives inherent in mainstream multidimensional poverty measures
title_ja: 主流の多次元貧困尺度に固有の逆インセンティブに対する即効的な修正策
summary_ja: 主流の多次元貧困尺度に潜む逆インセンティブ問題を扱っていると推測される。
既存の貧困測定枠組みが抱える課題への簡便な修正策の提案であると推測される。
要旨が提供されていないため具体的手法や実証の有無等の詳細は不明である。
reason_ja: 多次元貧困指数の問題点と測定手法の改善論に関心がある研究者にお薦めと推測されるため。

title: Fairness and incentives in combinatorial assignment
title_ja: 組み合わせ割り当てにおける公平性とインセンティブ
abstract: We consider the fair and efficient random assignment of indivisible goods subject to resource constraints. Agents receive bundles randomly, but individual lotteries over bundles that are feasible in expectation need not be jointly feasible. Consequently, we treat a lottery over feasible allocations as a public good. We show that every feasible finite economy admits an envy-free and Pareto efficient random assignment that may be supported as a Lindahl equilibrium. For a finite type space with specified expected utilities, we construct a mechanism whose outcomes are exactly feasible and Pareto efficient with respect to reported preferences. As the population grows and empirical type proportions and per-capita resources approach a limiting large economy, envy and gains from manipulation vanish. The approximate incentive compatibility of the mechanism holds for all type profiles that approximate the limiting economy. The argument combines sensitivity bounds for linear programs with proximity bounds between fractional and integer optima.
summary_ja: リソース制約下の不可分財割り当てに公共財的アプローチを導入する。
リンダール均衡として支持される羨望フリーかつ効率的な割り当てを示す。
経済規模の拡大に伴い羨望と操作による得が消失する耐戦略性を証明する。
reason_ja: 不可分財の公平分配と耐戦略性の近似成立を論じているため。

title: The Entangled Veil: Why Redistribution Requires a New Language
title_ja: もつれた無知のヴェール：なぜ再分配には新しい言語が必要なのか
abstract: The Rawlsian veil of ignorance requires choosing principles of justice without knowing which position-temporal, spatial, social, or personal one will occupy. We argue that this object cannot be represented faithfully within standard economic models. A faithful representation must satisfy three requirements: it must treat all generations symmetrically, capture non-separable correlations among positions, and allow mobility costs to vary across locations and occupations. We show that standard optimal-tax models violate at least one requirement, and that the minimal framework satisfying all three is a geometric framework adapted from string theory, in which the veil is an entangled state over a space of possible life situations. We derive full equalization as a first-best benchmark, the emergence of separated clusters when correlations reward distinction, a symmetry between intraand inter-generational equity, and a tunneling mechanism by which correlations reduce institutional barriers. The model generates four inequality profiles and four inequality types. The estimates are quantitatively important: the framework changes the ranking of redistributive policies, and ignoring the margins it identifies leads to systematically biased policy evaluation.
summary_ja: ロールズの無知のヴェールを従来モデルで表現する限界を指摘する。
世代間対称性と位置間相関を捉えるため弦理論に応用された幾何学枠組みを提示。
量子もつれ概念を用いて新たな再分配政策の評価モデルを構築する。
reason_ja: 無知のヴェールと正義論を物理学的な新モデルで再解釈しているため。

title: A Deterministic Polynomial-Query Protocol for Envy-Free Cake Cutting
title_ja: 羨望フリーケーキ切り分け問題における決定性多項式クエリプロトコル
abstract: We give a deterministic protocol that divides a heterogeneous cake completely and without envy among $n$ agents using $O(n^6\log n)$ Robertson--Webb queries in the worst case. Valuations may be arbitrary nonnegative, nonatomic measures, and bundles may be disconnected. The protocol makes $O(n)$ calls to certified trimming, which uses $O(n^5\log n)$ queries on $n$ pieces. In a certified trim, each agent receives the end part, or suffix, of a different piece without envy, and every shortened piece has a witness tie leading back to a whole piece. At each step, the witness values the shortened suffix exactly as much as her own. For pieces of positive interval length with strictly increasing suffix values, the retained suffix lengths are unique, although their holders may differ. Candidate assignments share a table of value and cut queries. If the coordinatewise median of their value estimates fails a matching test, the test identifies an agent whose value is underestimated, ruling out at least half the remaining assignments. A weighted median of cut marks lets one repair step remove a small envy while allocating almost all of the residue. For complete envy-free chore allocation, the query bound is $O(n^7\log n)$.
summary_ja: n人の羨望フリーなケーキ分割を多項式クエリで達成する決定性手法を提案。
認証付きトリミングを活用し羨望のないサフィックス割り当てを効率化する。
完全羨望フリーな家事割り当て問題に対しても同様の計算界を導出する。
reason_ja: 公平分配（フェアディビジョン）の計算複雑性における大きな進展だから。

title: Anonymous and Strategy-Proof Social Choice under Uncertainty
title_ja: 不確実性下における匿名かつ耐戦略的な社会選択
summary_ja: 要旨がないため推測だが不確実性下での社会選択ルールを考察しているとみられる。
構成員を平等に扱う匿名性（anonymity）の条件を分析していると推測される。
虚偽の表明を防ぐ耐戦略性（strategy-proofness）の成立可能性を探る内容と思われる。
reason_ja: 社会選択理論の根幹である匿名性と耐戦略性を扱っていると推測されるため。

title: Large Economies with Social Types
title_ja: 社会的タイプを伴う大規模経済
abstract: This paper develops a new general equilibrium framework for large economies with social externalities, where agents have names as well as social types. Social types define the reference groups (neighborhoods, peers, or status classes) through which externalities operate, and are primitives of the market structure. We establish that every admissible economy admits a competitive equilibrium if and only if social anonymity holds. This condition requires that observable social types do not fully identify individuals within any non-negligible subeconomy. The framework extends to generalized large economies with incomplete preferences, indivisible goods, and production, and thus accommodates nonconvexity in preferences and consumption sets. Our proof replaces the standard aggregate convexification argument with conditional convexification. Applications include peer effects, social comparison, and risk sharing with local social benchmarks.
summary_ja: 個体名と参照グループを示す社会的タイプを持つ大規模経済モデルを構築。
競争均衡が存在するための必要十分条件として「社会的匿名性」を導出。
選好の非凸性や不可分財に対応しピア効果やリスク共有へ応用する。
reason_ja: 匿名性概念と外部性を組み込んだ一般均衡理論を展開しているため。

title: Principal Revelations of the Revelation Principle
title_ja: 顕示原理に対する主体の開示
abstract: I prove a converse to the revelation principle, arguing that it is a principle of optimism: if it must hold for all environments (in fact, even just those with private values and independent types) the principal must assume her favorite equilibrium is played by the agents. When the principal knows only that the prior lies in some set, she must additionally assume it is her favorite one. With private values, independent types, and quasilinear payoffs, however, unrestricted transfers allow the principal to approximate any mechanism's equilibrium payoff via a direct mechanism whose unique equilibrium is truthful.
summary_ja: 顕示原理の逆を証明し、本原理が最善の均衡プレイを前提とすることを主張。
事前分布が曖昧な場合、プリンシパルに好都合な分布の仮定が必要と示す。
準線形環境では直接メカニズムによる近似が達成可能であることを論じる。
reason_ja: メカニズムデザインの基礎である顕示原理の仮定と限界を再検証するため。

title: Stay or Switch? Metric Distortion with Online Candidate Arrivals
title_ja: 維持か変更か？候補者がオンライン到着する場合の距離歪み
abstract: We study metric distortion in sequential elections with online candidate arrivals. In each round, a newly arriving challenger competes against the incumbent, and a voting rule must select one of the two based on voters' pairwise preferences. Our goal is to guarantee low metric distortion at every round, relative to the best candidate among all those that have arrived so far. For deterministic rules, we establish an asymptotically optimal bound of $Θ(\sqrt{t})$ at round $t$, achieved by a threshold rule favoring the incumbent. In contrast, randomization allows constant distortion. We show that persistent randomized dictatorship achieves optimal distortion of $5$ against adaptive adversaries, which observe previous winners, and $3$ against oblivious adversaries, which do not. Finally, we generalize the model along two dimensions, the available information and the action space, and establish distortion guarantees for each setting.
summary_ja: 候補者が順次到着するオンライン投票における距離歪みを分析する。
決定性ルールでは現職優先閾値ルールにより最適界が得られると示す。
確率的ルールではランダム独裁制により歪みを定数に抑えられると実証する。
reason_ja: 歪み（distortion）理論を動的な候補者到着モデルに拡張しているため。

title: Proper and Optimal Scoring Rules for Risk-Averse Agents
title_ja: リスク回避的なエージェントに対する適正かつ最適なスコアリングルール
abstract: Scoring rules are used to elicit probabilistic beliefs through payments that depend on reports and realised outcomes. We ask how these rules should be designed to induce truthful reporting and incentivise costly information acquisition when the agent is risk averse. For agents with entropic risk preferences in finite state spaces, we characterise proper scoring rules through an exponential transformation, derive optimal structures for information acquisition under bounded payments, and obtain explicit optimal coefficients in the binary case. The risk-neutral limit preserves properness and, in the binary case, optimality, while recovering the optimal betting structure for nonbinary states. For optimal design in the binary model, it suffices to focus on rules whose associated concave function is affine on each side of the prior. The optimal coefficients depend only on the prior and the risk-aversion parameter. The binary optimal rules we construct also admit an exact transformation from a particular risk-neutral optimal rule. In the nonbinary model, optimal design reduces to choosing the best prior bound in a transformed betting mechanism.
summary_ja: リスク回避的エージェントから信念抽出と情報獲得を促すルールを設計。
エントロピー型リスク選好に対し指数変換による適正スコアリングルールを特定。
2状態モデルでの最適設計や非2状態モデルへの拡張可能性を提示する。
reason_ja: 意思決定理論におけるリスク選好と確率的信念抽出の関係を深掘りしているため。

title: Heterogeneous Risk-Sensitive Evolutionary Learning in Coordination Games: Polarization, Welfare Loss, and Intervention for Efficiency
title_ja: 調整ゲームにおける異種リスク感応型進化学習：極化、福祉損失、および効率的介入
abstract: We study evolutionary learning in coordination games in a finite population of agents with heterogeneous risk attitudes, modeled using the entropic risk measure (ERM). The population consists of two subpopulations, each with a fixed risk attitude. Under risk-sensitive best response with mutations (BRM), we characterize the long-run outcomes of the learning process. In particular, we characterize when a polarized state, in which the two subpopulations choose different actions, is uniquely stochastically stable in terms of agents' risk attitudes and the subpopulation sizes. Notably, this polarized state is strictly Pareto dominated by the payoff-dominant equilibrium under both expected payoffs and agents' own ERM-adjusted payoffs. Moreover, its welfare, measured by average expected payoff, is always lower than that of the payoff-dominant equilibrium and can also be lower than that of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, heterogeneity of risk attitudes in learning alone can lead to an inefficient long-run outcome. To mitigate such inefficiency, we propose intervention mechanisms to modify agents' risk attitudes in learning. We show that a sufficiently large intervention share (the fraction of agents modified) and sufficiently high intervention intensity (the increase in their risk parameter) ensure that the payoff-dominant equilibrium is uniquely stochastically stable. However, greater intervention intensity cannot compensate for an insufficient intervention share, and a larger intervention share cannot compensate for insufficient intervention intensity.
summary_ja: 異なるリスク態度を持つ集団における調整ゲームの進化動学を分析した。
異質性により極化状態が唯一の確率的安定状態となり効率性が低下する。
介入率と強度の双方を十分に高めることで社会的最適を回復できる。
reason_ja: リスク選好の異質性と集団の意思決定・社会的効率性を扱っているため。

title: Matching with Generalized Sequential Choice Rules
title_ja: 拡張された逐次選択ルールを用いたマッチング
summary_ja: 逐次選択ルールを一般化した環境でのマッチング理論に関する研究と推測される。
選択ルールの性質が安定性や実現可能な配分に与える影響を分析したと推測される。
個人の意思決定プロセスの拡張が市場結果に与える影響の解明を意図していると思われる。
reason_ja: 意思決定ルールを拡張したマッチング理論に関心がある研究者に好適なため。

title: What it is to Obey
title_ja: 服従とは何か
abstract: Prior to agents taking part in a simultaneous-move game, a designer commits a device that sends signals to each of the agents, evaluating the resulting set of equilibria according to a (Hausdorff-)continuous function. In games of incomplete information I show that it must be without loss of optimality for the designer to restrict attention to direct obedient devices if and only if she assumes her preferred equilibrium will be played. In games of complete information, I characterize the monotone evaluations, which include both the maximally optimistic one and the maximally pessimistic one.
summary_ja: ゲーム開始前の情報伝達装置における服従（相関均衡）シグナル条件を分析した。
不完全情報ゲームでは望ましい均衡実現の前提下で直感的シグナルに限定可能と証明。
完全情報ゲームにおいて最良・最悪評価を含む単調評価関数をキャラクタライズした。
reason_ja: 情報構造設計と均衡の服従条件に焦点を当てた意思決定理論の研究であるため。

title: A Constant-Factor Single-Sample Prophet Inequality for Subadditive Valuations
title_ja: 劣加法的評価に対する定数因子の単一標本預言者不等式
abstract: We establish a constant-factor single-sample prophet inequality for online combinatorial allocation with monotone subadditive valuations. Given one independent sample from each buyer's unknown distribution, our reduction converts any offline algorithm achieving an $α$ fraction of optimal welfare into an online algorithm achieving an $α/120$ fraction of the expected offline optimum. The guarantee holds for arbitrary arrival orders and extends to the stronger Game of Googol model. Our approach has two key ingredients: a prior-free random score generator and a new sample-based construction of tentative allocations. The tentative allocations capture substantial welfare while controlling contention for items, and the score generator relates itemwise competition in the tentative allocations to the value of retained bundles. The reduction is efficient whenever its offline allocator and score generator are efficient.
summary_ja: 単一の標本から単調劣加法的評価をもつ組合せ配分の預言者不等式を構築した。
オフラインアルゴリズムをオンラインでの定数近似保証へ変換する手法を提案した。
任意の到着順序やより強いGoogolゲームモデルに対しても保証が成立することを示した。
reason_ja: 標本に基づくオンライン選択問題やメカニズムデザインに関心のある研究者に適すため。

title: Optimal Matroid Prophets against Almighty Adversaries and Delegation
title_ja: 全能の敵対者に対する最適マトロイド預言者不等式と委任
abstract: We prove an optimal one-half matroid prophet inequality against an almighty ordering adversary: the adversary observes every realized value before choosing the arrival order, whereas the algorithm sees values only as they arrive and must accept irrevocably. The algorithm is deterministic, and its guarantee holds against the stronger ex-ante relaxation. Before any values are revealed, it partitions the ground set, replaces the matroid by a stricter direct sum of minors, and fixes one threshold for each part. It then accepts greedily subject to these fixed tests. The main lemma bounds the expected value of the least valuable basis of the eligible elements. An element contributes either through the rank spanned by eligible elements or through excess value that every eligible basis must retain. This bound holds simultaneously for all bases and therefore permits the arrival order to depend on the entire realization. The same construction gives a deterministic, agent-oblivious mechanism for (possibly correlated) matroid delegation, improving the $1/4$ guarantee to the optimal $1/2$ factor. The principal values are independent, while the strictly positive agent utilities may have arbitrary dependence on the principal values and on one another. The guarantee holds for every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. Both factors are tight already in rank one. For rational finite-support distributions, preprocessing takes polynomial time; each eligible online arrival requires at most one query to the original matroid's independence oracle.
summary_ja: 最悪の到着順を決める敵対者に対し最適率1/2を達成する確定的なマトロイド法を証明。
基底集合の分割と各部分への固定閾値適用により確定的な受容判定を実現した。
本手法を応用し相関のあるマトロイド委任問題でも最適係数1/2を達成できると示した。
reason_ja: 動的選択アルゴリズムと代理人への意思決定の委任問題を深掘りしているため。

title: The Oracle Is Not Enough: Secure Settlement for Prediction Markets
title_ja: オラクルだけでは不十分：予測市場のための安全な決済
abstract: Prediction markets are becoming an important mechanism for aggregating information and forecasting uncertain real-world events. As they grow in scale and value, reliable settlement becomes critical because settlement determines the winning outcome and allocation of market collateral. Yet many heterogeneous markets require market-specific evidence and interpretation, and incorrect settlement can create direct financial incentives for manipulation. In this paper, we ask how to settle heterogeneous markets correctly and efficiently at scale. We first compare existing settlement designs in their support for heterogeneous markets, reliance on direct operator intervention, and resistance to manipulation, motivating a layered architecture that combines incentivized crowdsourcing with stake-backed voting and selective post-settlement review. Building on this architecture, we develop a stake-backed settlement protocol that provides economic security and settlement liveness under market-specific verification costs. Specifically, we prove that manipulation is unprofitable for every settled market and give two constructions that support sufficient self-enforcing participation with controlled reward expenditure. Using historical Polymarket and UMA data, we evaluate the protocol under real-world conditions. We find that 99% of admitted markets can be settled with modest participation rewards even under high verification costs.
summary_ja: 予測市場の正確な決済に向けクラウドソーシングとステーク投票の階層構造を提示した。
検証コスト下で不正操作を不利益化し経済的安全性を保証するプロトコルを設計した。
実データ評価により99%の市場が少ない報酬支出で安全に決済可能と実証した。
reason_ja: 予測市場を通じた情報集約と制度設計の安全性を論じているため。

title: Coarse Price Discrimination
title_ja: 粗い価格差別
abstract: We study the revenue cost of limiting a seller to $L$ posted prices when heterogeneous buyers with independent values compete for scarce inventory. Our large-market assumption requires that removing any buyer have little effect on optimal revenue. We first make buyers arbitrarily replaceable at each fixed stock and then let stock grow. In this limit, one price guarantees half of optimal mechanism revenue and two guarantee $e/(e+1)$, approximately $73.1\%$. For $L\ge3$, the corresponding guarantee is a $1-1/(2L-1)$ fraction. The guarantees accommodate arbitrary differences in demand across buyers and do not require a separate price for each customer group.
summary_ja: 売り手が提示可能な価格をL個に制限した際の収益損失率を理論的に分析した。
大規模市場下で価格が1つでも最適収益の半分、2つで約73.1%を確保できると証明。
顧客群ごとに個別の価格を提示しなくても高い収益率が得られることを提示した。
reason_ja: 価格設定の制約が意思決定者の収益や市場配分に与える影響を論じるため。

title: Optimal Regret Lower Bounds in Matrix Games
title_ja: 行列ゲームにおける最適リグレット下限
abstract: We study learning in two-player zero-sum games, also known as matrix games, in which two players with $m$ and $n$ actions repeatedly select mixed strategies for $T$ rounds. The learning dynamics based on optimistic Hedge guarantee regrets of $O(\log(mn))$, which improve to $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ if each player knows the number of actions of the opponent, whereas matching regret lower bounds have been known only for specific learning dynamics. We prove that, for every deterministic learning dynamic, there exists a payoff matrix for which the maximum individual regret is $Ω(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ for a wide range of $m$ and $n$. Together with the upper bound $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$, this lower bound shows that the minimax regret of deterministic learning dynamics in matrix games is $Θ(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ in this regime. For all $m$, $n$, and $T$, we also prove the lower bound $Ω(\min\{T,\log\min\{m,n\}\})$. These lower bounds hold even if each player also observes the strategies and the feedback of the opponent. Our main technical contribution is an adaptive construction of the payoff matrix. While running the algorithms of the two players, we add in each round a rank-one matrix that keeps the feedback of the previous rounds unchanged and increases a lower bound on the sum of the regrets of the two players. As by-products, we obtain lower bounds on the rate at which the average strategies converge to a Nash equilibrium and on the query complexity of matrix-vector products that deterministic algorithms need to compute an approximate Nash equilibrium.
summary_ja: 2人ゼロサム行列ゲームにおける確定的な学習動学のリグレット下限を証明した。
最大個別リグレットがΩ(√(log m log n))となる利得行列の存在を明示。
既存上限と合わせて決定論的学習におけるミニマックスリグレットのタイトな評価を導出した。
reason_ja: 繰り返しゲームにおける対戦者の学習動学と限界に関心を持つ研究者に好適なため。

title: Privacy-Preserving Disclosure and Welfare
title_ja: プライバシー保護情報開示と余剰
abstract: We consider a monopolist selling to multiple buyers. A platform observes buyers' tastes and can publicly disclose information about those tastes. However, the platform faces a privacy constraint: the disclosure must reveal nothing about any individual buyer's taste. We show that the same pairs of consumer and producer surplus are attainable with or without this constraint. For each such pair, we construct a privacy-preserving disclosure rule under which a posted-price mechanism attains the pair and no other feasible selling mechanism earns more.
summary_ja: 単一の独占販売者が複数の買い手に販売する市場モデルを考察した。
個人の嗜好を一切開示しないプライバシー制約下の厚生を分析した。
制約の有無にかかわらず同一の消費者・生産者余剰が達成可能と示した。
reason_ja: プライバシー制約と厚生の関係をメカニズムデザインで扱う研究に役立ちます。

title: Contests versus Contracts in Innovation Procurement
title_ja: イノベーション調達におけるコンテスト対契約
abstract: How much competition should a designer introduce when procuring innovation? We study a designer funding multiple technological approaches whose feasibility is learned through experimentation. Between independent contracts and contests, we introduce interdependent contracts, which combine approach-specific rewards with continuation decisions that depend on rivals' outcomes. When both breakthroughs and breakdowns are contractable, these contracts implement the optimum by extracting firms' rents and coordinating experimentation across approaches. When only breakthroughs are contractable, we compare simple mechanisms with constant contractual payments. Under technological symmetry, optimal interdependent contracts terminate experimentation at a success cutoff or deadline. Fixed-prize contests can implement the same innovation outcomes, but their relative expenditure depends on the experimentation horizon: for interior success cutoffs, contests are more expensive when the horizon is short and less expensive when it is sufficiently long. Rank-contingent contests can weakly outperform constant-payment interdependent contracts, but technological heterogeneity can reverse this ranking because individualized contracts better tailor incentives to different approaches. We further characterize optimal interdependent contracts with time-varying payments, extending the comparison beyond simple mechanisms. Our results show how outcome contractability, technological heterogeneity, and payment flexibility shape the desirable form of competition in innovation procurement.
summary_ja: イノベーション調達において導入すべき最適な競争の形態を検討した。
成功と失敗の双方が契約可能な場合、相互依存契約が最適結果を生む。
成功のみ契約可能な場合、期間や技術の異質性で最適なメカニズムが変わる。
reason_ja: 契約理論やコンテスト設計、実験を通じた情報獲得の研究に強い示唆を与えます。

title: Query-Sample Tradeoffs for Revenue Maximization
title_ja: 収益最大化におけるクエリとサンプルのトレードオフ
abstract: We introduce and study the full query-sample tradeoff for revenue maximization with a single buyer whose value follows an unknown distribution. A learner may adaptively combine value samples, which reveal full buyer values, with pricing queries, which reveal only whether a fresh buyer accepts a selected price. The goal is to learn a price that achieves a $(1-\varepsilon)$-multiplicative approximation to optimal revenue with high probability. We ask when, and by how much, reducing the sample budget increases the number of pricing queries required. We establish tight tradeoff bounds for monotone-hazard-rate (MHR), regular, and quasi-monotone-hazard-rate (quasi-MHR) distributions, and almost tight bounds for quasi-regular distributions. Our results reveal sharply different benefits from combining the two information sources. Quasi-MHR distributions admit a smooth intermediate tradeoff: additional samples can reduce the query requirement by polynomial factors. For MHR and regular distributions, however, a sufficiently small constant fraction of the sample-only requirement still leaves the learner facing the full asymptotic query cost attainable with one sample. Our upper bounds are achieved by algorithms that collect all value samples before making queries, while our lower bounds hold even under arbitrary adaptive interleaving of the two forms of access. Along the way, we also fully characterize the sample-only and single-sample query complexities for all four families, eliminating the extra logarithmic dependence on $1/\varepsilon$ in the literature.
summary_ja: 買い手の価値分布が未知の単一買主における収益最大化を分析した。
価値サンプルと価格設定クエリの獲得コストのトレードオフを導出した。
分布の性質によって情報源相互の代替性・補完性が変化することを示した。
reason_ja: 情報獲得と未知環境での最適意思決定を理論的に解明したい研究者に適しています。

title: Selling Training Data
title_ja: 訓練データの販売
abstract: This paper studies the sale of supplementary training dataset to improve predictive model. The buyer not only has private knowledge of its own dataset, but also can choose the way to merge these two datasets. This flexibility imposes a new constraint on the menu, requiring the buyer's total net utility be monotonic in the Blackwell order on private datasets. Given that, we show that a single posted price for a fully informative dataset is optimal in hypothesis testing, under differential virtual-value condition. The result extends to multi-class classification in which private datasets share a clean component but differ in how their labels are contaminated.
summary_ja: 予測モデル改善に向けた追加訓練データの販売メカニズムを解明した。
買い手によるデータ結合の柔軟性がBlackwell順序上の単調性を課す。
差分仮想価値条件のもとで全情報データの単一提示価格が最適と示した。
reason_ja: Blackwell情報順序を用いたデータ販売メカニズムに関心のある研究者に適します。

title: Collateral Architecture and Correlated Slashing in Liquid Restaking
title_ja: リキッド・リステーキングにおける担保構造と相関スラッシング
abstract: Liquid restaking protocols allow pooled stake to support multiple slashable commitments, creating an allocation problem in which additional rewards must be balanced against correlated slash claims. This risk depends not only on dependence between slash events, but also on how collateral is allocated or reused across commitments. We develop a unified model ranging from unique stake, where capital is divided among positions, to shared collateral, where the same capital supports multiple commitments. We show that portfolio variance is governed jointly by gross exposure, exposure concentration, and failure dependence. Spreading fixed capital reduces risk toward a correlation-dependent floor, whereas repeatedly pledging the same collateral can make risk grow quadratically with breadth. We then study risk-sensitive allocators competing for fixed reward pools distributed proportionally to committed exposure. A single allocator has a unique optimum, and in a symmetric benchmark greater risk sensitivity encourages diversification under unique stake but discourages additional commitments under shared collateral. With multiple allocators, positive background stake guarantees a unique pure Nash equilibrium and supports a globally convergent projected method. Reproducible synthetic stress tests support these mechanisms. In the strongest common-factor environment, relaxing the reuse cap raises equilibrium reward by 2.47 times but aggregate 99% conditional value at risk by 3.77 times. Competition creates overexposure relative to a planner, while ignoring covariance raises true variance by 6.3%. The results provide a unified framework for collateral reuse, correlated operational risk, and incentive design in decentralized security markets.
summary_ja: リステーキングにおける担保の再利用と相関リスクを統一モデル化した。
固有担保と共有担保でのリスク感受性ある参加者のゲーム行動を解析した。
個々の競合行為が社会最適に比べ過剰なエクスポージャーを生むと示した。
reason_ja: リスク配分や相関事象を伴うインセンティブ設計を扱う研究者に最適です。

title: Volunteer's Dilemma With Social Learning
title_ja: 社会的学習を伴うボランティアのジレンマ
abstract: We study the interaction of observational learning and free‐riding through a dynamic volunteer's dilemma: If one member of a group performs a costly task, a public good that benefits everyone equally is produced. The value of the public good is uncertain, and each individual receives a private signal about it. The central mechanism is that members make inferences about each other's private signals by observing their actions, while aware of their free‐riding incentives. The main findings concern the probability of public good provision and information aggregation. First, the probability of provision is nonmonotonic with respect to population size: If the population is small, increasing it to a certain threshold leads to an upward jump in the probability of provision. Above this threshold, the probability of provision gradually decreases as population size increases. Second, due to free‐riding incentives, there are no information cascades in equilibrium even when the population is arbitrarily large: Learning becomes slower as population grows, and social learning never outweighs the private signal.
summary_ja: 観察学習とフリーライディングが混在する動的ボランティアのジレンマを分析した。
公共財提供確率は集団規模に関して非単調な推移を示すことを解明した。
フリーライディング誘因の存在により情報カスケードが発生しないと証明した。
reason_ja: 集団意思決定や情報集約、社会的学習の限界に興味がある研究者におすすめです。

title: Dynamics of inequality of opportunity in wage earnings in India: a machine learning approach
title_ja: インドにおける賃金収入の機会不平等の動態：機械学習アプローチ
summary_ja: 本文要旨が未公開のため論文タイトルから内容を推測する。
インドにおける賃金収入の機会不平等の動態を扱う研究である。
機械学習手法を適用し、機会不平等の経年変化を推測・分析する。
reason_ja: 機械学習を用いた機会不平等測定の手法やインドの実証動向の把握に役立つ。

title: The Intergenerational Transmission of Disadvantage in Euro​pe: A Latent Class Analysis
title_ja: ヨーロッパにおける不利の世代間伝達：潜在クラス分析
abstract: Comparative research on the intergenerational transmission of socioeconomic disadvantage remains limited, largely due to a lack of harmonised information on parental circumstances. To address this limitation, we propose using latent class analysis to identify disadvantaged groups by incorporating measures of education, social class, financial hardship and material deprivation. We draw on the 2019 EU-SILC ad​-hoc retrospective module, which provides information on respondents and their parents to provide transition matrices and summary mobility indices across thirty European countries. Our results show substantial variation in disadvantage persistence and provide a robust ranking of countries. These findings contribute to comparative research by showing how disadvantage is reproduced across generations in Europe.
summary_ja: 標準化データ不足に対処するため、潜在クラス分析による同定手法を提案。
教育、社会階級、経済的困窮、物質的剥奪を組み合わせて不利グループを特定。
2019年EU-SILCを用い、欧州30カ国の不利の世代間継続性を比較。
reason_ja: 欧州諸国の不利の世代間伝達に関する最新の比較実証と測定手法が学べる。

title: Envy-Free Cake-Cutting for Five Agents
title_ja: 5人のエージェントにおける羨望フリーなケーキ分割
abstract: We study the envy-free cake-cutting problem, in which a divisible resource must be divided among a set of agents with heterogeneous preferences in a way that ensures that no agent envies the piece obtained by another. Remarkably, under some mild continuity assumptions on the agent valuations, it is known that an envy-free division where each agent receives a \emph{connected} piece of the cake is always guaranteed to exist. When the valuations are monotone, prior work has shown that a connected $\varepsilon$-envy-free division can be obtained using $\poly(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries for up to four agents, leaving the case of five or more agents open. In this work, we develop a new simpler approach that yields such an efficient algorithm for five agents. Our algorithm uses $\mathcal{O}(\log^3(1/\varepsilon))$ queries and also yields a novel proof of existence for five agents that does not rely on any fixed-point theorems beyond the intermediate value theorem.
summary_ja: 異質な選好を持つエージェント間で、各々が連結した断片を受け取る羨望フリー（envy-free）なケーキ分割問題を扱う。
4人までは対数的なクエリ数で近似解が得られることが既知だったが、本研究は5人の場合に効率的なアルゴリズムを開発した。
中間値の定理のみに基づき、不動点定理を用いない5人での存在証明と、対数的なクエリ計算量を達成した。
reason_ja: ケーキ分割問題における5人以上の未解決事例に、新たな計算手法で挑んでいるため。

title: Approximate MMS allocations for large number of agents
title_ja: 多数のエージェントに対する近似的な最大最小シェア配分
abstract: We consider allocation of indivisible items to agents with non-negative additive valuations, under the maximin share (MMS) fairness benchmark. We prove that for every $ρ< 1$, there exists some $n_ρ$ such that every allocation instance with $n \ge n_ρ$ agents has a $ρ$-MMS allocation. This was explicitly stated as a conjecture in a recent paper of the authors, where it was shown to hold if the number of items is at most $(2 - ε)n$ (and $n \ge n_{ρ, ε}$). We build on some techniques from that earlier paper, including the construction of $\textit{ordinal MMS}$ allocations that give $n - O(\log^2 n)$ agents their full MMS. Among the new techniques that we introduce is the definition of $\textit{block-matchings}$ between the MMS partitions of two agents, and a proof that if the number of item types is small, then block-matchings of small width necessarily exist.
summary_ja: 非負の加法的評価を持つエージェントへの不可分財配分において、最大最小シェア（MMS）の公平性基準を検討する。
エージェント数nが十分に大きい場合、任意の近似率ρ < 1に対してρ-MMS配分が存在することを証明した。
順序MMS配分や、MMS分割間の「ブロックマッチング」という新概念を導入し、財の種類が少ない場合の存在性を示した。
reason_ja: MMS配分の存在性に関する重要な予想を、多数のエージェントという条件下で解決したため。

title: Improved Downward-Closed Delegation Bounds
title_ja: 下方閉な実行可能制約下における委譲の改善された境界
abstract: We study delegated choice under a downward-closed feasibility constraint, where the principal and agent values of each item may be arbitrarily correlated but items are independent. We give a deterministic, agent-oblivious menu that guarantees the principal more than $29/70\approx0.41429$ of the expected offline optimum under every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. The menu depends only on the feasible family and the principal's value distributions, and verifies a proposal using only its items and their principal values. The previous best guarantee for downward-closed constraints was $0.1098$. Matroid constraints admit a guarantee of one half, which is tight already in rank one, but downward-closed constraints do not: a five-item knapsack instance bounds every deterministic menu by $500/1011$ of the optimum, and no rule with randomized acceptance, even one that knows the agent's utilities, can guarantee more than $30/61$. An explicit computer-assisted family of instances lowers the bound to $0.48105$ for all such rules. The guarantee is proved by contradiction. If every menu in a fixed family earns at most a $29/70$ fraction of the optimum, then a normalized instance satisfies a finite system of affine inequalities among the survival functions, stop-loss transforms and overshoot means of its clipped optima. An exact rational certificate shows that the system is infeasible. We also give a short analytic proof that a single threshold on the reported total value guarantees $3/10$.
summary_ja: 本人と代理人の価値が相関し、財が独立な下方閉（downward-closed）制約下での委譲選択問題を分析する。
決定論的かつ代理人に依存しないメニューにより、オフライン最適値の約0.414倍以上の期待値を保証する手法を提案した。
従来の保証値0.1098を大幅に改善し、計算機支援による上界の導出や、閾値ルールによる簡潔な証明も提示している。
reason_ja: 委譲メカニズム設計における近似保証の限界を、下方閉制約という一般設定で更新したため。
